title: Safar
desc: In love with Neela, Avinash urges her to wed another man, sacrificing his own happiness. The fragile marriage unravels when her husband grows suspicious of Avinash.

title: Humjoli
desc: Gopaldas marries heiress Roopa to get rich. His greed spirals out of control when he plots her murder to inherit her wealth.

title: Biwi Ho To Aisi
desc: Suraj secretly marries Shalu, a village belle, defying his domineering mother Kamla. To drive Shalu away, Kamla falsely accuses her of stealing jewellery and money.

title: Saathi
desc: Suraj and Amar witness their father's murder. Later, Suraj embraces crime while Amar resists, leading to conflict between brothers torn apart by choices, loyalty, and vengeance.

title: Sarfarosh
desc: Framed and imprisoned by three men, an honest patriot swears revenge. Standing in his path is an upright police officer-unaware that the man he hunts is his own father.

title: Badal
desc: Badal sees his family being killed in a riot. Raised by a terrorist, he sets out to avenge them by targeting the officer responsible for their deaths.

title: Baaghi
desc: Defiant Saajan abandons his home for Kaajal, the woman he loves, trapped under Dhanraj's control in a brothel. Shunned by his family, the lovers flee to escape Dhanraj's wrath.

title: Yaraana
desc: JB, who isn't mentally stable, forces Lalita into marriage. But Lalita pretends to faint and escapes on her wedding day, hoping to take control of her life.

title: Koi Mere Dil Se Pooche
desc: Aman Puri falls in love with Esha Singh and gets ready for the wedding. But, the wedding is disrupted by Dushant, who claims that Esha is his wife.

title: Apne Paraye
desc: Wealthy Sidheshwari hands over household control to her sister-in-law Sheila, but peace is soon threatened when Harish arrives with his cunning wife Naintara, who plots to manipulate her.

title: Muqabala
desc: Two feared gangsters declare a truce and strike up an unlikely friendship, but their hard-won peace shatters when both fall for the same woman and refuse to let love go.

title: Tapasya
desc: Indu, eldest daughter of a sick man, falls for her father's doctor. But her lover's mother demands she abandon her family and place her in-laws above all else.

title: Gold
desc: Tapan Das managed India's hockey team after independence. He faces many challenges as he fights to lead the team to win an Olympic gold medal for the nation.

title: Fox
desc: Arjun, a brilliant yet corrupt criminal lawyer who never loses a case, resolves to reform his life. His redemption is shaken when he is suddenly accused of murdering five people.

title: Ajay
desc: Ajay decent man from middleclass family,finds his whole family murdered.He decides to work for Rupesh,a criminal.While working with him,Ajay finds a clue leading him to the killer.

title: Coolie No. 1
desc: A matchmaker tricks Raju, a coolie, into acting like a rich man so he can marry Hoshiyar Chand's daughter and teach her arrogant father a lesson in humility.
